properties.title: EchoJEPA: A Latent Predictive Foundation Model for Echocardiography

properties.version_basis: PDF identified by SHA-256 against assignments.json; title page read.

properties.description: Latent-predictive echocardiography encoder evaluated by frozen-backbone probes on view classification, LVEF and RVSP, with a compute-matched pixel-reconstruction comparison, acoustic perturbation tests and pediatric transfer.
properties.independent_study_claim: single study; the strongest model is trained on proprietary data

properties.description: Frozen EchoJEPA encoder plus multi-view attentive probe with view and clip embeddings and view dropout.
properties.world_model_status: representation encoder, not a transition model

properties.algorithm: EchoJEPA-G (V-JEPA2 adapted, ViT-Giant, latent masked prediction)
properties.world_model_status: representation encoder only (not_world_model; supporting component, not a transition model)

properties.population: echocardiography patients, adult and pediatric transthoracic and some transesophageal studies
properties.decision: view triage, LVEF and RVSP estimation as research benchmarks; clinical use is not endorsed

Pretraining corpus described as 18.1M proprietary videos from 300K patients across scanner manufacturers

Relation of the pretraining corpus to the probe sites
assertions.rationale: Dataset identity is partly stated, variable-level provenance is not.
No study dates, acquisition clocks or timestamp semantics are described beyond sampling frame rates.
Nothing is said about when study measurements, reports or labels become available.
A binary view-availability mask and a key padding mask make missing views distinguishable from observed ones. No result under missing views is reported.

assertions.applicability_reason: [design] Each clip or study is a single acquisition processed independently, so staleness of a measurement relative to a prediction time has no subject.
[design] Clips are sampled at fixed frame rates and there is no irregular longitudinal series.

assertions.rationale: Acquisition and operator variability is named as motivation, but the observation process is not audited or described.

assertions.applicability_reason: [design] No clinical clocks or longitudinal timestamps are used, so a clock audit has no subject.

criteria_met: ImageNet-statistics normalization, resolution fixing and echo-specific augmentation ranges are specified
criteria_missing: Unit and label mapping across datasets
assertions.rationale: Preprocessing only.

No patient-level split statement is given for pretraining versus probe training and testing, and whether the Toronto, Chicago or public cohorts overlap the 18.1M pretraining videos is not stated. The grid search reports the best configuration per model without naming the selection set.
How the proprietary multi-site corpus was assembled is not described.
ViT-Giant and ViT-Large video encoders trained with the latent objective are evaluated by frozen probes on three tasks (Tables 3, 4, 6).

EchoJEPA-L initializes from ViT-Large weights pretrained on natural video and loads the encoder directly, with the predictor randomly initialized. The checkpoint name is not given and EchoJEPA-G initialization is not stated.

The training objective is L1 on predicted versus EMA-target embeddings. The compute-matched comparison with EchoMAE-L (Tables 2 and 10) shows lower LVEF MAE and higher view accuracy for the latent objective.

criteria_met: EMA target encoder with stop-gradient is the stated anti-collapse mechanism
criteria_missing: Any collapse monitor, rank or variance diagnostic
assertions.rationale: Mechanism specified, not tested.
EchoJEPA predicts embeddings and does not reconstruct pixels. Pixel reconstruction is used only by the comparator EchoMAE-L.

Multi-view fusion in the probe adds factorized view and clip embeddings and cross-attends over all tokens. The RVSP results (Table 6) use it for apical and subcostal views. The fusion component is not ablated.

criteria_met: Key padding mask ignores missing views and view dropout of 0.1 is used in training
criteria_missing: Ablation of dropout or the mask
assertions.rationale: Specified, not evaluated.

The encoder embeds one clip and masked tubelets of the same clip are predicted. No state is carried across time or visits. A per-clip embedding exists, which is why the legacy Has-state cell says Partial.
The embeddings and targets are point vectors with an L1 loss. No belief distribution is represented.

relation_assertions.rationale: A reusable echocardiography representation encoder evaluated by frozen probes; no temporal transition or action exists, so only the component profile fits.
Reviewer mapping only: the frozen encoder is an evaluated representation component and the embeddings could feed a belief-state service. No state transition is evaluated.
Reviewer mapping only: the frozen encoder is an evaluated representation component and the embeddings could feed a belief-state service. No state transition is evaluated.

capability_assessments.rationale: EchoJEPA is a learned representation encoder evaluated by frozen probes, label-efficiency curves, external-site and pediatric transfer, and a compute-matched comparison. However, it predicts masked spatial tubelets (full temporal mask scale 1.0 in Table 8) of the same clip rather than advancing a persistent state across time; state.persistent and dynamics.temporal are assessed absent, and cardiac dynamics modeling is explicitly deferred to future work (p. 8). Because the necessary core world-model identity conditions are not met, the ontology capability level is not_world_model (supporting encoder component, BP_COMPONENT).

legacy_cells.AJ: ViT-Giant (EchoJEPA-G) and ViT-Large (EchoJEPA-L) video encoders; a predictor and attentive probe are also described
legacy_cells.AL: Latent predictive L1 loss between predicted masked-region embeddings and stop-gradient exponential-moving-average target-encoder embeddings
legacy_cells.AM: Early fusion by concatenating video tokens with factorized view and clip embeddings, followed by self-attention and cross-attention pooling
legacy_cells.AN: Random view dropout (p=0.1) during training and a binary view-availability mask in the attentive probe
legacy_cells.AZ: Attention visualizations show localization on valve leaflets and ventricular walls; UMAP visualizations show view clusters
legacy_cells.BT: Linear task heads/probes for 12-class view classification, LVEF regression, and RVSP regression
legacy_cells.BV: L1 latent-prediction loss against EMA target embeddings; compute-matched VideoMAE comparator uses masked-patch pixel reconstruction
legacy_cells.BX: EchoJEPA-G pretraining: 18.1M echocardiogram videos across 300K patients; EchoJEPA-L: 525K MIMIC-IV-Echo videos
legacy_cells.BY: EchoJEPA-G ViT-Giant: 1.1B parameters; EchoJEPA-L ViT-Large: 300M parameters
legacy_cells.CA: Compute-matched EchoJEPA-L/VideoMAE pretraining: single 8-GPU NVIDIA H100 node; 84,000 optimizer updates per model
legacy_cells.DN: Toronto internal studies; Chicago internal holdout studies; EchoNet-Dynamic; EchoNet-Pediatric; MIMIC-IV-Echo
legacy_cells.DQ: Toronto: 150,000 studies; Chicago: 60,000 studies; EchoNet-Dynamic: 10,030 videos; EchoNet-Pediatric: 3,316 videos; MIMIC-IV-Echo: 525K videos; proprietary pretraining corpus: 18.1M videos across 300K patients
legacy_cells.EG: Sample efficiency: EchoJEPA-L achieved 57.55% view-classification accuracy with 1% labels; EchoJEPA-G achieved 78.63%; EchoPrime achieved 42.1% with 100% labels
legacy_cells.EI: Compared with VideoMAE/EchoMAE-L, PanEcho, and EchoPrime; reported LVEF, RVSP, view-classification, robustness, sample-efficiency, and pediatric-transfer results
legacy_cells.EK: RVSP ablations removed stream embeddings, early fusion, or view dropout; MAE increased from 4.54 mmHg to 4.63, 5.09, and 5.37, respectively
legacy_cells.FB: Learned continuous embeddings of spatiotemporal echocardiography tubelets and clip streams; no persistent physiological state or treatment-transition model is defined
legacy_cells.FL: A ViT encoder processes visible spatiotemporal video tubelets; a predictor infers masked-region embeddings against an EMA target encoder. A frozen multi-view attentive probe fuses view/clip tokens and feeds task heads.
legacy_cells.FM: Introduces EchoJEPA, a latent-predictive echocardiography foundation model, plus a standardized multi-view probing framework and ultrasound-specific robustness evaluations.
legacy_cells.FN: EchoJEPA-L exceeded the compute-matched reconstruction model on LVEF MAE and view accuracy; EchoJEPA-G reported LVEF MAE 4.26 on Toronto and 3.97 on Stanford, RVSP MAE 4.54/4.91 mmHg on Toronto/Chicago, and 78.63% view accuracy with 1% labels. EchoJEPA-G also reported pediatric zero-shot LVEF MAE 4.32 and 2.3% average degradation under acoustic perturbations.
legacy_cells.FO: Authors report reliance on proprietary data for the strongest model, synthetic rather than prospective clinical perturbations, and potential privacy risks from memorization requiring further study.
legacy_cells.FP: Authors propose prospective validation in patients with poor acoustic windows, cardiac-dynamics modeling for treatment-effect prediction, interpretable reasoning, finer-grained tasks, and extension to other noisy modalities.
legacy_cells.FQ: Authors state that echocardiography foundation models struggle to separate anatomical signal from stochastic speckle and acquisition artifacts, and that standard i.i.d. evaluation misses ultrasound-specific degradation.
legacy_cells.FR: The experiments evaluate learned representations and probe outputs, not persistent physiological-state transitions, treatment-conditioned forecasts, identified counterfactual effects, multi-step rollouts, planning, or prospective clinical benefit. The authors identify cardiac-dynamics/treatment-effect prediction and prospective validation as future work.
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M2 Encoders; M3 Belief-state service; M7 Outcome & causal layer
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Expose the learned representation through a modality encoder/state interface, then independently validate next-state prediction before using it for simulation or control.
legacy_cells.FU: Reviewer mapping (KB §20): Incomplete multimodal state construction
legacy_cells.FX: PDF pp. 1–19: title and abstract; Introduction and Related Work; Methods §§3.1–3.5; Experiments §§4.1–4.7 and Tables 1–7; Discussion, Limitations, Future Work, Conclusion, and Impact Statement; Appendices A–D, including Tables 8–17. | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. legacy_cells.FZ: The full extracted text was reviewed through page 19. Table 10 in Appendix B has garbled column alignment in the text extraction and was not relied on for extracted values. This paper demonstrates a latent representation encoder and downstream probes, not a persistent patient-state transition, treatment-conditioned rollout, causal treatment effect, or planner. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis. limitations: Original review used text-only tables and skimmed references/Appendix C parameter tables. Targeted 2026-11-22 review read full bibliography entries (pp. 9–11), read Appendix C parameter tables in detail, and directly inspected table images on pp. 4,6,7,13–19 (Tables 1–17). Cited full studies and released assets remain unretrieved.

No code or weights were inspected, so release statements are author claims. The comparison to EchoPrime and PanEcho changes data scale and objective at once, and only EchoJEPA-L versus EchoMAE-L is compute-matched.
Tables 3, 5, 6 and 7 report single values with no intervals. The pretraining corpus of the flagship model is proprietary, and its overlap with the probe cohorts is not stated.
Legacy cells were read from the root workbook row (read only). Unlisted columns remain imported-only.

Schema validity and quote occurrence do not establish semantic correctness. One reviewer pass; no independent human review.

Phase E repair visually inspected rendered pages 13-19 (confirming Tables 8-17 and Equations 6-15, including Table 8 temporal mask scale 1.0 and Table 17 RVSP ablation on p. 19) and corrected capability_assessments from L0 to not_world_model because core world-model identity (state.persistent, dynamics.temporal) is absent.
notes: EchoJEPA is a latent-predictive echocardiography encoder evaluated by frozen probes. It fits L0 (representation evaluated) and the supporting-component profile. It is not a core world model because no state transition is specified. Notable source points: the Stanford LVEF column is described as zero-shot in the dataset list but as probes trained on EchoNet-Dynamic in the Table 3 footnote, perturbation definitions differ between Section 3.5 and Appendix C, and the pretraining and probe cohorts overlap is unstated.
